title: Whoop styles
description: A big display heading over a row of bold pill tabs (the current one filled black, the rest outlined in grey) that scrolls sideways on phones. Each tab shows a large square photo with 30px corners and a semibold title, a paragraph and a black pill button; panels crossfade (0.3s) when the tab changes. The photo sits above the text on phones and beside it on desktop.
notes: all panels are in the static HTML; only the first is visible until JavaScript runs
